title: Bobby Ray Inman tape recorded at the IDA

tellings.quote: >> a lot was the the tape with um um uh Bobby R Bobby Rinman >> when he got asked those questions. That was at the IDA.

plain: There is a tape of Bobby Ray Inman, a former senior intelligence official, being put the questions on this subject, and it was recorded at the Institute for Defense Analyses, a defence research centre. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron mentions the tape to Michels without saying who made it. He treats it as a time a top official was pressed on UFOs on the record.
